message:
fix: preserve restored sessions and concurrent draft candidates

Keep the initial UI placeholder out of pending session writes until a real server session or recoverable local candidate is available. Preserve later reconnect edits and defer initial navigation until recovery.

Treat known draft ancestors as prior writes, merge late receipts with observed revisions and conflicts, and retain explicit choices independently through concurrent writes and storage failure. Cover both real storage delivery orders, selected-candidate recovery, and initial session restoration without weakening existing browser assertions.
